name: @w6w-apps/kudosity
description: Send SMS, MMS, WhatsApp and RCS messages, check RCS reachability, read message history and manage webhooks with Kudosity's Transmit Message API v2.

w6w.longDescription:
Kudosity (formerly Transmit SMS, Burst SMS and ClickSend-style bulk messaging for Australia, New Zealand, the UK and the US) is an A2P messaging platform: one account, one API key, several channels. This app covers the Transmit Message API v2 — the current, single-key API — so a workflow can send an SMS, an MMS, a templated or free-form WhatsApp message, or an RCS message, and read any of them back with delivery status.

Beyond sending, it can check whether a list of numbers can receive RCS before you choose a channel, list message history per channel with the filters each endpoint documents (cursor-paged for WhatsApp and RCS, page-numbered for SMS), manage the webhooks that push delivery receipts, inbound replies, link hits and opt-outs to your own endpoint, and list the sender registrations on the account.

Health checks probe the v2 gateway without a credential — a schema-correct 401 proves it is serving — because Kudosity publishes no status page and no rate-limit or usage signal. The older Transmit SMS v1 API (key and secret, HTTP Basic) is deliberately not covered here.
